Field.name: ArticleBrand
Field.description: A mandatory field used to identify the brand name of the article. See the Article, Brand, Category (ABC) User's Guide or Section 5.6.2(B) for additional information.

Field.name: ArticleSerialNumber
Field.description: A mandatory field if the OAN is not used. It provides the identification number of an item of property.

Field.name: OwnerAppliedNumber
Field.description: A unique identification number or inscription which is permanently stamped, etched, engraved or welded on an item of property by its owner, (e.g., drivers license or social security number). OAN is mandatory for entry if the SER is not available on the property. NOTE: Pawn/Buy transactions do not require SER or OAN if CAT is A or N.

Field.name: Name
Field.description: The name of the person associated to this record.

Field.name: OwnerAppliedNumber
Field.description: An identification number which is permanently engraved, etched, stamped, or welded on a vessel or vessel part. Do not enter OANs which are: painted, decals, commercial signs or peel-off labels - these belong in the MIS field. State assigned BHNs with the prefix CFZ must be placed in the BHN field. OAN is mandatory in boat entries if REG and BHN are not used. OAN is mandatory in boat part records if SER is not used. The computer converts all alphabetic Os in the OAN to zeros.

Field.name: RegistrationNumber
Field.description: The vessel registration number (Certification of Registration in DMV) or the document number issued by the Coast Guard. Mandatory in Entry Transactions if BHN and OAN are not used. California registered vessels have CF as the first 2 characters. The REG cannot be same as the CGD.

Field.name: GunCaliber
Field.description: Caliber is the diameter of the bore and refers to the size of the bullet. A mandatory field that covers caliber 0003 through 1211 with three exceptions: 1. 0000 is used with pistols when only the frame is available. When using Cal/0000, 'Frame only' must be entered in the first 10 positions of the Miscellaneous Field (MIS). 2. 8888 is used to describe the caliber of a firearm that can be fitted with interchangeable barrels or cylinders of different calibers or which is a multiple barrel firearm using different calibers such as an over/under rifle and shotgun. 3. 9999 is used with unusualfirearms or destructive devices in conjunction with type Z firearms. The Miscellaneous field should be used when needed to further describe the caliber. In case of problems, contact the Automated Firearms Unit at (916) 227-3687.

Field.name: GunMake
Field.description: A mandatory field containing the name, brand, or make of a firearm as assigned by NCIC

Field.name: GunSerialNumber
Field.description: The serial number on a firearm is a mandatory field. The NCIC Gun File provides only eleven characters for the serial number; thus, a firearm with a serial number up to 14 characters in length which is accepted in AFS would be rejected by NCIC. If a 14 character serial numbered gun is to be entered into NCIC (ENT/2), use the last eleven characters of the serial number (right to left) and put the complete number in the XRF field. NCIC will accept the record. The complete serial number will be in the Miscellaneous Field.
